read: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% on Monday, Nov 23 and fell 2.4% over the past week. The VIX closed at 26.6.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 20 bp to 4.92%, oil fell 6.5%, gold fell 5.2%, the dollar rose 0.7%, and chip stocks fell 17.8%.
Strongest sector this week: Consumer staples (−2.0%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−17.8%).
The biggest news themes right now: AI & chips, Inflation, jobs & economy, Fed & interest rates.
